column1: # init-errors.tsv: init with a stored volume=33 (u8) under failure injection. Columns as defaults.tsv. flash_init_* fail the first flash init only (later flash init succeeds); a flash init that reports no-free-pages or a new version means: erase everything, init again (stored volume then gone). init_result 'error' = init returned a non-OK code (getters then show whatever state applies: defaults).
